import importlib.util
import unittest
import uuid
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SCRIPT_PATH = ROOT / "scripts" / "import_course_seeds_by_routes.py"
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("course_seed_importer", SCRIPT_PATH)
MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
assert SPEC and SPEC.loader
SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)


class CourseSeedCatalogTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_new_catalog_entity_uses_deterministic_identity(self):
        importer = MODULE.CourseSeedImporter(ROOT / "db" / "seeds" / "test" / "routes")
        importer.translation_payload = lambda *_: [
            {"i18n_id": 1, "title": "Трек", "description": "Описание"},
            {"i18n_id": 2, "title": "Track", "description": "Description"},
        ]
        importer.catalog_entity_id = lambda *_: None
        requests = []

        def request(method, path, body=None, **_):
            requests.append((method, path, body))
            return {"id": body["id"]}

        importer.api_request = request
        item = {"slug": "programming-languages", "status": 1}
        first_id = importer.ensure_catalog_entity("track", "tracks", item, {}, "Track")
        second_id = importer.ensure_catalog_entity("track", "tracks", item, {}, "Track")

        source_key = "seed.catalog/track/programming-languages"
        expected_id = str(uuid.uuid5(uuid.NAMESPACE_URL, f"ms-go-course:{source_key}"))
        self.assertEqual(first_id, expected_id)
        self.assertEqual(second_id, expected_id)
        self.assertEqual(requests[0][2]["source_key"], source_key)
        self.assertEqual(requests[0][2]["id"], expected_id)

    def test_existing_catalog_entity_is_updated_without_replacing_identity(self):
        importer = MODULE.CourseSeedImporter(ROOT / "db" / "seeds" / "test" / "routes")
        importer.translation_payload = lambda *_: []
        importer.catalog_entity_id = lambda *_: "9cdd012b-44ce-4f26-872e-1a0c214e2316"
        requests = []
        importer.api_request = lambda method, path, body=None, **_: requests.append((method, path, body))

        result = importer.ensure_catalog_entity("track", "tracks", {"slug": "backend"}, {}, "Track")

        self.assertEqual(result, "9cdd012b-44ce-4f26-872e-1a0c214e2316")
        self.assertEqual(requests, [("PUT", "/track/update/9cdd012b-44ce-4f26-872e-1a0c214e2316", {"slug": "backend", "status": 1, "translations": []})])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
